modeling_decisions: Retain complete roof between two end planes, thick enclosing shell and interior scallop recesses. Concept image is front-exposed module; do not convert to missing-roof cutaway. Short enough that front and rear internal geometry genuinely visible without render-only hidden surfaces. Cross section asymmetric broad oval with mildly flattened floor, not circular hose. Multiple unequal smooth-edged faceted scallops are recessed into wall mesh, no pasted hemispheres. Actual Cleveland photo has tour trail/edging/lights: omit these human features rather than claim untouched exact morphology. Same neutral material must still reveal scallops.
repair_decisions: Actual diagnostic-3 hero/clay/top inspected. Enclosed module and two cut boundaries preserved but interior not readable from hero; outer envelope too smoothly pipe-like. Repair radial recess units, make true unequal wall/roof hollows with shallow relief in meters and more irregular envelope, and use a genuinely oblique front module cut boundary exposing interior rather than renderer-only surface removal. Original two cut-end enclosed-module scope unchanged; module shape/cut-plane orientation disclosed before new geometry.
